newsitem.title: USA: Gleason Corp to buy Hermann Pfauter Group.
newsitem.headline: Gleason Corp to buy Hermann Pfauter Group.

text.p: Gleason Corp said Wednesday said it had agreed to acquire Hermann Pfauter Group, which manufactures cylindrical gear production equipment, for an undisclosed amount.
The deal includes Pfauter's 76 percent interest in Pfauter Maag Cutting Tools Inc, a U.S.-based producer of cylindrical gear cutting tools, Gleason said.
Hermann Pfauter Group is based in Ludwigsburg, Germany. It has major operating locations in Germany, the United States and Italy, and about 1,050 employees worldwide.
Combined sales for the Pfauter operations were about $175 million in 1995, Gleason said.
The purchase price will be paid in cash with an option for up to 25 percent of the consideration to be paid in Gleason common stock, the company said.
The deal is expected to close before the end of the year.
